meta.title: Meridian — Global financial routing
meta.description: Non-custodial routing hub for businesses and AI agents: compare traditional finance, stablecoin and wholesale liquidity routes. Meridian never holds funds or keys and does not execute, settle, or custody funds.

landing.title: Rank every route your money could take, before it moves.
landing.lede: Meridian reads a financial intent, compares routes across banks, FX, stablecoins and liquidity, checks compliance, and returns the best-execution decision. Your licensed partners settle.
landing.noncustodialNote: Non-custodial by design — never holds funds or keys, never moves money on your behalf.
landing.trustLine: Built for fintechs, platforms and treasuries operating across borders

model.heading: One layer, three jobs
model.sub: Meridian sits above every rail and does three things — and deliberately none of the fourth: it never executes or holds.

coordinate.title: Coordinate

states.emptyBody: Enter an amount and a currency pair to compare bank FX, payment institution, stablecoin and wholesale liquidity routes side by side. Every route is priced against the mid-market rate, so the all-in cost is comparable.

comparison.cardDescription: Every route is priced against the mid-market rate, so a zero-fee quote on a wide spread cannot look cheaper than an explicit fee on a keen rate.
comparison.deliveredHint: The amount delivered is calculated per route.
comparison.amountHintWhole: {currency} has no minor unit — enter a whole amount.
comparison.expiredBody: At least one provider's price has lapsed, so this ranking no longer reflects what you can get. Refresh to compare live quotes.
comparison.alternativeHint: ranked by the same scoring, shown for the comparison
comparison.providerFailures: {count, plural, one {# provider could not quote} other {# providers could not quote}}
comparison.providerFeeHint: All provider charges, valued at mid
comparison.slippageLine: Includes {bps} of expected execution slippage at this notional.
comparison.middleLeg: Quoted middle leg in {asset}. Meridian never holds the asset and does not settle this corridor.
comparison.costComparisonHint: All-in cost of each route against the same mid-market benchmark, so the bars are comparable.
comparison.savesVsMostExpensive: Best route saves {amount} against the most expensive option.
comparison.chargedByMeridian: Charged by Meridian, not the provider
comparison.roundingHint: Sub-minor-unit residue, so the breakdown balances exactly
comparison.breakdownCaption: All figures in {currency}, measured against a mid-market benchmark of {amount}.
comparison.shortValidityHint: Short validity — refresh for a live quote

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Weights cost most heavily, then settlement speed, then provider reliability.

cost.label: Lowest cost
cost.description: Ranks purely on all-in cost against the mid-market benchmark.

speed.label: Fastest settlement
speed.description: Prioritises settlement time, accepting a higher cost to move sooner.

reliability.label: Most reliable
reliability.description: Favours providers with the strongest historical settlement record.

verify.reproduced: Replayed to an identical result and fingerprint.

partner.title: Transact directly with {provider}
partner.body1: Meridian is a comparison platform. It does not hold funds, execute transactions or touch the money at any point — you transact with the provider you choose, on their terms.
partner.body2: A direct hand-off to licensed partners is planned. Until it ships, use this quote as your negotiating reference with {provider}: the mid-market benchmark, the offered rate and every fee are itemised in the route details.
partner.indicative: Quotes are indicative and non-binding. No funds move through Meridian.

licensing.sandboxHint: Unlicensed sandbox pricing. Indicative only; not a licensed institution.
licensing.licensedHint: Licensed partner quote under a commercial agreement.
licensing.internalHint: Internal pricing model (benchmark or modelled curve), not a live licensed quote.

login.title: Organization sign in
login.lede: The dashboard shows quotes, transactions and savings for your organization only. Public route comparison stays available without an account.
login.mfaBody: This account requires an authenticator code or a unused recovery code before a session is issued.
login.ssoBody: Off by default. When your organization has enabled OIDC, sign in with the organization slug. Unmapped identities are rejected.
login.demoBody: Sandbox only. This login is committed on purpose so local development does not need a secrets manager.

invite.title: Accept organization invite
invite.lede: Meridian is invite-only for this cohort. An operator creates the organization and issues the first owner invite. Accepting sets your password; it does not verify KYB, attach pricing, or enable execution.
invite.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Not a documented demo secret.

sso.title: Organization SSO
sso.lede: Completing federated sign-in. A session is issued only for an existing organization member — unmapped identities are rejected.
sso.providerRejected: The identity provider rejected the sign-in.

dashboard.overviewLede: Figures below are computed from quotes and transaction requests stored for {name}. Another organization's rows never enter these queries.
dashboard.noQuotesStoredBody: Compare a route while signed in, or load the sandbox demo tenant, and the metrics and charts will fill from that stored data.
dashboard.revenueLinkLead: Quoted platform fees, take rate and the revenue lifecycle live on
dashboard.revenueLinkTrail: . Those figures are quoted or attributed, not collected.
dashboard.metricVolumeHint: Sum of transaction requests, counted once per payment rather than once per quote.
dashboard.metricSavingsHint: Recommended route cost versus the most expensive quote on the same request.
dashboard.metricQuotesHint: Every stored provider quote scoped to this organization.
dashboard.metricSuccessfulHint: Requests that reached quoted or quote-selected status.
dashboard.metricAvgCostHint: Mean all-in cost of recommended quotes, in basis points against mid-market.
dashboard.metricAvgSettlementHint: Mean p50 settlement time of recommended quotes.
dashboard.quotesLede: Provider prices stored for this organization. Cross-tenant identifiers never appear here.
dashboard.noQuotesOrgBody: A comparison run while signed in writes quotes against your tenant. The public comparison page does not attach an organization.
dashboard.transactionsLede: Priced requests, not settlements. Meridian never records a payment moving.
dashboard.noTransactionsBody: Requests appear here after this organization asks the engine to price a corridor.
dashboard.providersLede: Usage is derived from this organization's stored quotes, not from a global catalogue.
dashboard.noProviderUsageBody: Providers appear once this organization has at least one stored quote.
dashboard.revenueLede: Multi-rail monetization for {name}. Figures are quoted platform fees, not settlements. Every amount is computed with Decimal arithmetic over integer minor units. A pricing shape that is switched off is absent from these totals rather than shown as zero. Another organization's events never enter them.
dashboard.noRevenueBody: Compare a route while signed in, quote an agent payment, or load the sandbox demo tenant. The ledger records attributed fees only — funds never move.
dashboard.invoicesLede: Monthly platform-fee invoices copied from recorded monetization snapshots. Issued is not collected: each invoice carries its own collection status, and only one collected against a processor reference is cash received.
dashboard.noInvoicesBody: Invoices are generated at month-end from execution-intent and subscription snapshots. Route quotes are never billed. Nothing here means cash was received.
dashboard.settingsLede: Membership and API key prefixes for {name}. Secrets are never returned.
dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.noMembersBody: This organization has no active members.
dashboard.chartVolumeHint: Transaction request notional in the last 30 days, taken from stored requests.
dashboard.chartCostHint: Mean all-in cost of the recommended quote each day, in basis points.
dashboard.chartProvidersHint: How often each rail was priced for this organization.
dashboard.chartEmpty: No stored rows in this window. Charts are built from database data only — they stay empty until this organization has quotes.
dashboard.invoiceDetailLede: Line items copy platform revenue from named monetization snapshots. Totals use integer minor units and tax is always zero. This invoice is cash received, and counts toward realized revenue, only if its collection status reads collected and a processor reference stands behind it.
dashboard.taxHint: {method} — no jurisdiction rates in this phase.

onboarding.title: Organization onboarding
onboarding.lede: Sales-assisted, invite-only. Each step below is the live backend state for {name} — not a preview of work that has not happened.
onboarding.eligibleTitle: KYB and contracted pricing are complete
onboarding.eligibleBody: This organization may receive licensed-provider quotes once a partner of record exists. Execution stays unimplemented (POST /api/v1/executions → 501). Customer funds never touch Meridian.
onboarding.notEligibleBody: Sandbox and demo quotes are available for exploration. Licensed-provider quotes and any future execution require verified KYB and an explicit CustomerPricing rule. Onboarding itself does not enable execution.
onboarding.orgExists: Tenant {id} exists. New organizations start with no elevated scopes.
onboarding.kybPendingDetail: Submitted for manual review. A vendor timeout or error never auto-approves.
onboarding.kybVerifiedDetail: Manual review recorded a verified decision.
onboarding.kybNotSubmitted: Not submitted. Sandbox quotes stay available; licensed quotes stay blocked.
onboarding.pricingConfigured: An explicit CustomerPricing rule is in force. Zero take-rate counts only when that row exists.
onboarding.pricingMissing: No CustomerPricing row. There is no silent default take-rate.
onboarding.apiKeyIssued: At least one unrevoked organization API key exists. Issue further keys from Settings.
onboarding.apiKeyMissing: No API key yet. Owners and admins issue keys from Settings after the rest of onboarding.
onboarding.openSettings: Open settings to issue an API key
onboarding.licensedBlockedTitle: Licensed quoting is still blocked at the platform
onboarding.licensedBlockedBody: PHASE 30 has no named licensed partner of record. Completing this checklist does not invent one, and it does not turn executions on.
onboarding.kybSubmitBody: Submit this organization for manual Know-Your-Business review. No vendor is contractually confirmed yet, so an operator records verified or rejected with an audited reason. A vendor failure never auto-approves.

agents.publicLede: Agents request a payment in natural language. Meridian interprets that into a structured intent, then the deterministic routing engine quotes and ranks rails. The parser never computes rates, fees, slippage or settlement amounts. The platform never custodies an external operating account and never moves funds.
agents.dashLede: Quoted volume, fees, success rate, spending limits and policy denials for agents in {name}. Completed means the sandbox simulator finished — funds never move, and Meridian never holds a key or generates a wallet.
agents.noAgentsBody: Issue an agent from Settings or the agents API. Dashboard figures appear after the agent quotes or the sandbox demo tenant is loaded.
agents.simulatorLede: Create a payment intent from natural language, quote routes, authorize, and simulate. The parser only interprets intent. This is not custody and not a wallet.
agents.metricVolumeHint: Quoted and simulated notional in the reporting asset. Includes failed intents.
agents.metricFeeHint: Mean all-in cost of the selected, recommended or first quoted route.
agents.metricSuccessHint: Completed simulations divided by completed plus failed.
agents.metricViolationsHint: Fail-closed denials recorded for this agent.
agents.instructionExample: Pay 1,000 USD to this merchant using the cheapest compliant route.
agents.signInRequiredBody: Agent payment intents are scoped to an organization. Sign in as the demo treasury operator to create an intent, request a quote, authorize, and run the sandbox simulator. The platform never holds the agent wallet.
agents.noAgentsExplorerBody: Issue an agent from the API, or load the sandbox demo tenant. Agents act for the organization and never custody funds here.
agents.createIntentBody: An instruction such as {example} becomes a structured intent. The policy engine runs before quotes and before an execution intent is recorded. A violation fails closed. The parser never prices the payment. Simulation never moves money.
agents.detailLede: Financial activity for this agent. Quoted and simulated only — {funds}, custody is off, no wallets generated, no private keys held.
agents.noSpendingPolicyBody: This agent has no fail-closed policy yet. Limits appear here once a policy exists.
agents.spendingLimitsHint: Daily cap in {asset}. Remaining is limit minus completed and authorized simulations today (UTC).
agents.preferredRoutesHint: Selected, recommended or first quoted provider per intent. Ranked by count.
agents.noPolicyDenialsAgent: No policy denials recorded for this agent.
agents.violationsHint: Fail-closed denials scoped to this agent.
agents.paymentHistoryLede: Intents for {name}. Status SIMULATION_COMPLETED is a sandbox simulation. Funds never move.
agents.noPaymentIntentsBody: Quote an instruction in the sandbox simulator on the agents list, or load the demo tenant.
agents.policyPageLede: Fail-closed spending controls for {name}. Empty allow-lists mean none. This page does not create wallets, hold keys, or move funds.

pages.railsLede: Score Traditional Finance, stablecoin and DeFi quotes with one framework. Cost, speed, liquidity, finality, FX rate, slippage and compliance are computed from quotes — never from a model.
pages.graphLede: Assets and venues as a directed graph. Discover multi-hop conversions such as USD → USDC → USDT → KRW, then prune by hops, cost, liquidity, availability and compliance. Nothing here is a quote, a swap or a payout.
pages.defiLede: Quote DEX, AMM and aggregator venues on demo USDC/USDT, ETH/USDC and ETH/USDT pools. When a stablecoin ramp or traditional FX desk can price the same pair, those quotes are ranked together. Meridian never submits a swap, never connects a wallet, and never holds a key.
pages.stablecoinsLede: Quote USDC and USDT against fiat and against each other. Meridian never holds the token, never connects to mainnet, and never creates a wallet. Routes are discovered, priced and compared here; execution stays with an external provider.
pages.developersLede: Versioned quote, path search and catalogs under {path}. Authenticate with a session or an organization API key. Keys are hashed, scoped, expirable and revocable. {intent} records an execution intent — it never moves money.

pricing.note: Prices shown are indicative and subject to change. Meridian does not take a percentage of transaction value.
pricing.sandboxDesc: Free. Compare routes, explore the graph, test the API. No funds, no license.
pricing.starterDesc: Usage-based. Per-call metering for quotes, routes and compliance checks.
pricing.growthDesc: Subscription + usage. Higher quotas, priority routing intelligence.
pricing.enterpriseDesc: Custom. Volume agreements, dedicated support, custom corridors.
pricing.disclaimerBody: Plans and rates shown are illustrative and subject to change. Meridian charges for the decision layer — not a percentage of transaction value. Transaction-value pricing stays gated until applicable legal and partner requirements are met.
pricing.ctaBody: Spin up a sandbox to explore the graph and API at no cost. For enterprise volume or custom corridors, talk to sales.

about.heroTitle: We're building the decision layer for global money movement.
about.heroLede: Banks, FX, stablecoins, DeFi and tokenized assets each solve one slice of moving money — in their own silo. Meridian connects them as one route graph and returns the best path, without becoming any of them.
about.missionBody: We stay non-custodial on purpose: the decision is ours, the execution stays with licensed partners. Meridian compares every viable route, scores them on a single model, and returns a signed recommendation your systems can verify.
about.principle1Body: Meridian never holds customer funds, private keys or wallets. It returns decisions; regulated partners settle under their own authorizations.
about.principle2Body: The routing engine is the source of truth. Quotes, scores and signed intents are reproducible — never fabricated or modelled away from provider data.
about.principle3Body: Meridian does not act as principal, favour one rail over another, or take a cut of transaction value. Best execution is scored on comparable axes for every provider.
about.teamBody: Team profiles and leadership bios will appear here as we publish them.

careers.heroTitle: Build the layer that makes finance interoperable.
careers.heroLede: We're a small team building financial orchestration infrastructure. If you care about correctness, regulation-aware design and clean abstractions, we'd like to talk.
careers.whyBody: You will work on route discovery, compliance intelligence and signed execution intents — the decision layer above banks, FX, stablecoins and liquidity. We ship with regulatory clarity: Meridian compares and recommends; partners settle.
careers.rolesBody: Open positions will be listed here as we hire. Check back or contact us if you do not see a fit yet.
careers.workBody: Remote-friendly, async by default, with a bias for written design and deterministic systems. We prefer small, correct increments over big-bang releases.

partners.heroTitle: Execution stays with licensed partners. That's the point.
partners.heroLede: Meridian returns decisions; regulated banks, payment institutions, FX providers and settlement infrastructure execute them under their own licenses. If you operate licensed financial infrastructure, integrating as a Meridian execution partner puts your rails in front of every routed intent.
partners.type1Body: Correspondent and local clearing for fiat corridors. Quotes feed the route graph; settlement stays under your license.
partners.type2Body: PSPs and payment institutions that can price payout and collection rails for embedded routing.
partners.type3Body: Wholesale and retail FX desks whose rates normalize into the comparable cost model.
partners.type4Body: On/off-ramps and stable-to-stable venues that quote fiat ↔ stablecoin and stable ↔ stable legs.
partners.type5Body: Licensed settlement and treasury rails that execute the signed intent Meridian returns.
partners.integrationBody: Partners expose quoting and eligibility metadata to Meridian. We discover, score and return a signed execution intent; your systems or APIs execute under your authorizations. Meridian never holds funds or keys.
partners.ctaBody: Tell us about your licensed rails and corridors. We will follow up on technical integration and commercial terms.

brand.heroLede: Download logos, colour tokens and typography guidance for press, partners and product embeds. Do not imply custody, settlement or licensing beyond what Meridian actually provides.
brand.logosBody: Primary wordmark and icon assets are available on request. Maintain clear space equal to the height of the “M” icon. Do not distort, recolour outside the palette, or place on busy backgrounds.
brand.recommendColor: Recommend — success green for ranked routes
brand.typeBody: Headlines: Fraunces (Latin). Body and UI: Inter. CJK locales fall back to the sans CJK stack for display headings.
brand.usageBody: Use “Meridian returns decisions — partners settle” when describing the product. Never imply Meridian moves money, holds wallets or executes transactions.

contact.formHint: For API and routing questions, use the sandbox and OpenAPI reference — no account required to compare routes.

solCrossBorder.heroTitle: Find the best corridor for every cross-border intent.
solCrossBorder.heroLede: Compare bank FX, stablecoin and liquidity routes for the same corridor on one comparable model — total cost, settlement time and compliance eligibility side by side. Meridian returns the best route; your licensed partner settles it.
solCrossBorder.section1Body: Cross-border payouts are fragmented: bank FX, stablecoin ramps and wholesale liquidity each quote in their own format. Teams manually compare spreadsheets or integrate providers one at a time.
solCrossBorder.section2Body: Send one intent. Meridian searches the route graph, normalizes quotes, checks jurisdiction and eligibility, and scores every viable path on cost, speed, liquidity, reliability and compliance.
solCrossBorder.section3Body: A ranked decision and a signed execution intent your systems and licensed partners can verify. Meridian never holds funds or executes the payout.
solCrossBorder.ctaBody: Use the sandbox to compare corridors with no funds and no license required.

solTreasury.heroLede: Route treasury movements across rails for lowest total cost and predictable settlement time, with compliance pre-checked per jurisdiction. Non-custodial — Meridian never holds treasury funds.
solTreasury.section1Body: Fund subsidiaries, rebalance liquidity pools, and move between fiat and stablecoin treasuries — with every route scored on the same axes.
solTreasury.section2Body: Total cost against mid-market, settlement p50/p95, liquidity depth, provider reliability and corridor compliance feed a single best-execution ranking.
solTreasury.section3Body: Every decision is traceable with a signed intent and audit trail. Execution stays with your licensed banking and settlement partners.
solTreasury.ctaBody: Compare treasury corridors in the sandbox before connecting production partners.

solFintechs.heroTitle: Embed the decision layer. Skip integrating every rail.
solFintechs.heroLede: One API gives your product best-execution routing across banks, FX, stablecoins and liquidity — without you integrating each provider or touching customer funds. Meridian returns the decision; your users' licensed providers settle.
solFintechs.section1Body: Quote, route search and compliance checks via one API. Surface ranked routes and signed intents inside your product UI or agent workflows.
solFintechs.section2Body: Meridian never holds customer funds, keys or wallets. Your users transact with the provider they choose; you stay out of custody and settlement.
solFintechs.section3Body: Create a sandbox tenant, send an intent to /api/v1/quote, and inspect scored routes. No funds move — partners settle when you connect licensed execution.
solFintechs.ctaBody: Get API keys and explore the developer hub.

solPlatforms.heroTitle: Route on behalf of your users, across borders.
solPlatforms.heroLede: Give marketplace sellers, creators or merchants the best route for every payout intent, with compliance pre-checked per corridor. Meridian decides; licensed partners settle.
solPlatforms.section1Body: Seller payouts, creator remittances and merchant settlements — each intent compared across bank, FX and stablecoin rails for the destination corridor.
solPlatforms.section2Body: Jurisdiction, provider eligibility and screening are validated before a route returns. Ineligible hops are pruned, not hidden behind a generic quote.
solPlatforms.section3Body: A transparent ranked route with reasoning shown. The signed intent is a recommendation — execution stays with the licensed provider you or your user selects.
solPlatforms.ctaBody: Test corridor coverage in the sandbox, then talk to us about platform integration.

solEnterprises.heroTitle: Global corridor coverage, one decision layer.
solEnterprises.heroLede: Standardize how your organization chooses financial routes worldwide — one comparable model across every rail, with audit and reconciliation built in.
solEnterprises.section1Body: Banks, FX, stablecoins, DeFi liquidity and tokenized registries in one normalized graph — so treasury and operations teams compare apples to apples.
solEnterprises.section2Body: Signed execution intents, reproducible scoring and organization-scoped audit logs. Every decision traceable; no silent model overrides.
solEnterprises.section3Body: One API and policy layer for subsidiaries and business units. Licensed partners execute; Meridian never holds enterprise funds.
solEnterprises.ctaBody: Evaluate corridor coverage with your team in the sandbox or speak with sales about enterprise terms.

trustNonCustodial.heroTitle: Why Meridian never holds your funds.
trustNonCustodial.heroLede: Meridian is a decision layer, not a money mover. It compares routes and returns a signed execution intent — a recommendation. It does not hold customer funds, private keys or wallets; it does not act as principal; and it does not execute or delegate settlement. Regulated, licensed partners perform any actual movement of money under their own authorizations.
trustNonCustodial.does1Body: Find every viable route across rails and normalize their quotes into one comparable model.
trustNonCustodial.does2Body: Score routes on cost, speed, liquidity, reliability and compliance, and return the best one.
trustNonCustodial.does3Body: Return a signed execution intent your systems and licensed partners can verify and act on.
trustNonCustodial.boundaryBody: Meridian returns a signed execution intent — a recommendation. The customer or a licensed partner initiates any actual movement of money under their own authorization. Meridian never transmits funds on your behalf.
trustNonCustodial.signatureBody: The signature attests that the recommendation is authentic and unaltered. It does not authorize a fund movement, approve a transaction, or substitute for your partner’s settlement process.
trustNonCustodial.ctaBody: Walk through the four steps from intent to signed decision — then explore the route graph in the sandbox.

trustSecurity.heroLede: Meridian protects organization data, credentials and audit trails. We do not hold customer funds, private keys or wallets, and we do not claim certifications we have not earned.
trustSecurity.section1Body: API traffic uses TLS. Credentials are hashed with salted scrypt before storage; plaintext secrets are shown once at issuance and never returned again.
trustSecurity.section2Body: Quotes, transactions, agents and audit events are scoped to the authenticated organization. Cross-tenant identifiers do not appear in dashboard queries.
trustSecurity.section3Body: Request logs redact secrets. Routing decisions are reproducible from stored inputs — the deterministic engine is the source of truth, not a generative model.
